component.name: ArcheAge Classic Linux Launcher
component.summary: Get ArcheAge Classic running on Linux and keep your addons up to date

description.p: A free companion to the official ArcheAge Classic launcher. The official launcher still handles login and patching; this one handles what is hard on Linux around it, and manages your addons.

ul.li: Checks your system for what the game needs and gives the exact fix commands
Finds or downloads the official launcher and starts it with the right Wine build
Explains crashes from logs and memory use, with switches for known fixes
Installs, updates, rolls back and backs up addons from the community catalogue

description.p: It never changes game files, never touches the running game and never handles your login.
Updates itself, and comes as an AUR package and a Flatpak.
